history.summary: A freehold 1,539sqft 3BR at $2.50M / $1,624 PSF in a 2022 D15 boutique near Kembangan, priced ~18% below the $1,991 area median. Freehold, near-new and apparently cheap per-PSF, but the discount partly reflects a generously-sized unit, a new-launch-biased rate, and a small boutique block.
history.rating_rationale: The headline ~18% discount to median PSF is flattered by the 1,539sqft size — at $2.50M absolute this is a large freehold 3BR, not a cheap one, and the per-unit price sits in the thinner >$2.4M band. The 3.52% rate carries new-launch bias and only 32 txns, and Rymden 77 is a small boutique (limited liquidity, fewer facilities). Freehold + near-new + D15 East Coast keep it a respectable hold, but nothing here pushes it past Neutral.
red_flags: 1,539sqft inflates the 'cheap PSF' — $2.50M absolute is in a thinner band
3.52% rate has new-launch bias and only 32 txns
Boutique development — limited liquidity and facilities
780m to Kembangan is a moderate walk
catalysts: D15 East Coast deep buyer pool and lifestyle appeal
Large family layout differentiates from small new-launch stock
